items.title: John Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, October 18, 2023 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Larry © Fillius Jazz Archive -9- Goldings played piano and Steve Gadd was the drummer.

ctx.x: You also mentioned — it’s time to mention working with James Taylor and you spoke about his distinctive guitar playing which I found to be very interesting.

Well we did — the first part was Russ Titelman called me to play, do a date for him in August of 2001. And it was down at Clinton. And he had a song called “Mean Old Man.” And I was in the booth with my guitar and James came into the thing and he was showing me the chords. They had sort of a nutty chord sheet and James came in and he went — and he always whistles like, playing all the chords. And I’m going this is James Taylor sitting in front of me. And I could see Russ Titelman on the other side, outside the…

Goldings played piano and Steve Gadd was the drummer. And I remember when I played the track for Bucky, I said, “Hey listen to this.” So he heard the thing and then the second he heard [sings] the first chunk he said, “Who’s the rhythm player?” I said, “Thank you very much.” I said, I passed the test. So James said something to me like, “Well you’ve got to show me how you do that rhythm thing, that’s really great.” I mean he really liked the rhythm guitar. And I said to him, “Well you can show me that finger…
